name: Ne moli o pomoschi
source:
A young girl tries to solve a love triangle with the help of magic. But the magic intervention doesn't turn out the way she wanted.

[From [url=https://kosmocat.itch.io/dont-beg-for-help]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻女孩试图借助魔法解决三角恋。但魔法干预并没有达到她想要的效果。

[来自[url=https://kosmocat.itch.io/dont-beg-for-help]Itch.io[/url]]
